methodology: Phase 1 maximum three source-verified programmes per university. The maximum is a research ceiling, not a quota. Do not fabricate or force a third programme when official evidence is insufficient.

international_eligibility_methodology.university_level: Verify international-student accessibility using official university sources.
international_eligibility_methodology.programme_level: Verify whether the specific programme is accessible to international applicants when official evidence supports a programme-level conclusion.
international_eligibility_methodology.unknown_rule: Use unknown when official evidence is insufficient. Never infer eligibility from an English-language webpage alone.
